newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian stocks market - closing report.
newsitem.headline: Italian stocks market - closing report.

text.p: Italian shares extended early session gains to close firmer on Friday but off day's highs on the back of surging bond futures at new records, a stronger lira and optimism over rate cuts in the near future, traders said.
The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.9 percent higher at 10,485 after a peak at 10,534 and the Mib30 blue chip index ended 0.89 percent up at 15,706 after touching 15,794.

"The market got off to a good start thanks to a strong lira, dollar and Btp future and the picture's been the same all day with even FIB bourse futures breaching resistance, all of which sparked bit of late profit-taking," one dealer said.
December bourse futures were 157 bps up at 15,830 after a high at 15,900.
The Btp December futures contract on LIFFE set a new record high at 128.91 in late trade against a previous high of 128.70 set on November 25.
The lira was also up at its highest levels against the mark for over two years touching a quoted 984.10.
Energy group ENI, up 1.08 percent at 8,050 lire, saw a high of 8,090 during the session in heavy volume of over 48 million shares as it enters the MSCI index at 100 percent today.
Fiat was up 0.41 pct at 4,458 after a peak at 4,515 lire.
Telecoms were mixed with Telecom Italia off 0.03 pct at 3,544 but mobile phone operator TIM rose 0.97 pct to 3,547 and holding group Stet ended 1.82 pct higher at 6,451.
Financial holding Gemina slipped 0.54 pct to 778.3 lire after shareholders approved the hiving off of its industrial activities into a new company HPI.
TV and advertising group Mediaset was 0.9 pct down at 7,249 after rallying Thursday.
Olivetti closed 1.45 pct higher at 538.9 in good volume of over 14 million shares.
